workflow_runs.name: Codespell
workflow_runs.display_title: Add turn-scoped ephemeral context

head_commit.message:
Strip leading turn-scoped additional context fragments

Rename the model-visible wrapper to <additional_context_for_this_turn> and ignore a leading run of those fragments when parsing user message content items. This prevents turn-scoped context-only prefixes from being treated as durable user input while preserving normal contextual-user-message detection.

Update compact/model-visible snapshots and turn-start assertions to reflect the new wrapper and parsing behavior.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
